architecture_outline: Use Vue 3 Single-File Components with clear boundaries.
Separate UI, reusable reactive logic, API requests, and shared state when warranted.
Keep authoritative validation, prices, inventory, authentication, and payment verification on a backend.
reference_approach: For Weather Dashboard, implement Search for a city, Show loading, success, empty, and error states, Save recent searches without storing secrets, Make the layout responsive. Follow milestone order, keep state in one source of truth, and use the official documentation linked in the course.
review_checklist: Show loading, success, empty, and error states
Save recent searches without storing secrets
A normal and a failure/boundary case have repeatable evidence.
The build, runtime assumptions, and any untested paths are documented.
